part_number.note: 20-character PARTNO string (e.g. the relay CID reports PARTNO=0351RS021XA2E21X1XXX). No SEL Model Option Table / ordering-information document exists for this product and the data sheet carries no per-digit ordering figure, so this block is calibrated from real PARTNO strings in the instruction manual plus the QuickSet Device Part Number dialog. Only three positions are user-selectable in that dialog (IM Figure 3.6): position 12 = User Inputs/Outputs, position 13 = Communication Interface, position 14 = Communications Protocols; these are confirmed. All other positions are marked '*' (of no consequence to QuickSet), are fixed across observed real part numbers (except position 11, which varies but is undocumented), and are recorded at low confidence. Position 13 aligns with metadata model_to_layers position_13, which selects the rear-panel Ethernet drawings (D/E/F).
references: SEL-351RS Kestrel Instruction Manual (351RS_IM_20220510), Figure 3.6 'Setting the Part Number' and CID PARTNO examples

positions.label: Communication Interface
positions.source: SEL-351RS Instruction Manual Figure 3.6 (QuickSet Device Part Number dialog) + real PARTNO + metadata rear-panel drawings
positions.note: Second QuickSet-selectable position; aligns with metadata model_to_layers position_13 (D/E/F select the rear-panel Ethernet drawings i4942a/i4868b/i4937a). Option 'E' is confirmed verbatim by the QuickSet dialog and by real PARTNO 0351RS021XA2E21X1XXX. 'A' is observed in real PARTNO 0351RS021X31A11X1XXX. 'D' and 'F' descriptions are inferred from the data sheet Ethernet port options (dual copper / single fiber / dual fiber, internal Ethernet switch) and the dual-port rear drawings; treat A/D/F as low-confidence.

options.A: Single-port Ethernet variant (observed in real PARTNO; exact description undocumented)
